summary: Re-pin after a clean rebase onto 8a6d8aa5 (main after #826). Re-verified, not re-stamped: base is the current main tip, both commits marked, the two-commit split preserved, and the diff against the new base is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the diff reviewed at 3d2b3f38. ⭐ The adoption commit 4aedf80b still hashes eod_cron.sh to 380f1fc825e9f8b1e671cdfc25a5722b135cd72f915cc50d6a8b3064297da8c5 - exactly the production box file - so byte fidelity has now survived several rebases without being lost. Substance carried forward unchanged - ACCEPT. Every HIGH is measured-fixed by EXECUTION: the notified-marker is nested inside PYTHON_EXIT==0 AND report_complete, proven by an identical three-tick one-variable pair where the mutant latches on a MISSING push and never delivers the day's real numbers while HEAD delivers them; a crash retries and preserves eod_failed_*; --force writes only a scratch artifact and never sets the marker; an ntfy HTTP 500 is detected, logged and retried; guard exits emit distinct [EOD-CRON-SKIPPED] reasons so a weekend is no longer byte-identical to a crash. Installer ownership corrected to -o trader -g trader matching both siblings; fails closed on non-root, missing or non-executable eod_counts.py, a crontab not referencing the target, and absent ntfy config, all before any mutation; exec bits committed 100755. set -euo pipefail correctly REJECTED with the reason stated. ⛔ REQUIRED FOLLOW-UP, unchanged: the mutant reverting the latch to file-existence SURVIVES and is NOT equivalent - seeding a partial canonical report, exactly what the adopted script produced, makes it push an empty verdict line forever while HEAD regenerates and delivers. Add a test that seeds a partial canonical and asserts the real report is produced. ⛔ DEPLOY ORDER: this installer refuses unless eod_counts.py is already installed - #826 landed and installed at 16:50 ET with sha256 113b86ec (the corrected version, not the original box file c6d4cea4), so the prerequisite is satisfied. ⛔ RESIDUAL for the handoff: if cron itself never fires - crond dead, crontab lost, box down - there is still ZERO evidence anywhere; the heartbeat proves observability only WHEN the wrapper runs, so from the ntfy channel a dead cron and a weekend remain indistinguishable. Needs a separate watchdog.
